subject: District Communication Strategy and Technology Roadmap
overview: The subcommittee discussed developing a district-wide communication strategy, focusing on technical platform integration and improved engagement with diverse stakeholder groups and PTOs.

items.title: Meeting Objectives and Strategic Goals
items.summary: Chair Jenny Graham introduced the subcommittee's task of developing a communications roadmap to improve technical systems and reach all district families.

items.title: Current Communication Challenges and Strategic Plan
items.summary: Administrators discussed how the COVID-19 pandemic has shifted communication focus toward operational updates while working to establish a new strategic plan centered on culturally proficient outreach.

items.title: Review of Technical Platforms: SchoolBrains and School Messenger
items.summary: The committee reviewed how the district student information system syncs with its communication tools and discussed enabling elementary school parents to update their own contact data to reduce errors.

items.title: Stakeholder Feedback from PTO Representatives
items.summary: PTO representatives requested better access to family contact lists and highlighted the difficulty of managing multiple communication apps like ClassDojo, Remind, and A2Z Connect.

items.title: Proposed Migration to Blackboard Platform
items.summary: Dr. Peter Cushing proposed replacing School Messenger with the Blackboard platform next summer to provide better social media integration, texting capabilities, and centralized archiving.

items.title: Engagement Strategies for Underserved Subgroups
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent and the committee discussed the importance of translating communications into four core languages and using visual graphics to identify message types for non-English speakers.

items.title: Video Accessibility and Translation Services
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed using third-party services like Rev.com to provide subtitling and translations for district video updates to improve accessibility for hearing-impaired and non-English speaking families.

items.title: Future Meeting Planning
items.summary: The committee scheduled the April 6th meeting to focus exclusively on engagement strategies for underserved student subgroups.
